title: The Pale Well
author: Jude Villalobos
blurb: Zephyrine Sterling, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
